description: Source code for process management in a watchdog service, including starting/stopping processes, handling child process death, startup sequence coordination, and acknowledgments for service readiness.

methods.name: findServiceByNameInList
methods.description: Searches for a serviceDefinition in a list by service name.

methods.name: findServiceByPidInList
methods.description: Searches for a serviceDefinition in a list by process ID.

methods.name: executeStartOperation
methods.description: Starts services based on scope filter and name.

methods.name: executeStopOperation
methods.description: Stops services based on scope filter, name, and flags.

methods.name: handleDeadChild
methods.description: Handles cleanup and restart logic when a child process dies.

methods.name: startMonitorAckThread
methods.description: Starts a thread to monitor service acknowledgments during startup.

methods.name: allAcksReceived
methods.description: Finalizes startup sequence after all acknowledgments are received or timeout.

methods.name: monitorAckDelayCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked when acknowledgment wait times out.

methods.name: resetBadServiceDelayCallback
methods.description: Restores a service’s restart action after a delay if it was marked bad.

methods.name: performStartupSequence
methods.description: Coordinates the startup of services in phases, including timers and acknowledgments.
